name: Photography Studio: Booking to Deposit to Confirmation Chain

nodes.name: New Booking Submitted
nodes.notes: Fires the instant a client submits the booking form on example.com (session type, date, package price).

nodes.name: Create/Update Contact (CRM)
nodes.notes: Creates the client record if new, or updates it if they have booked before. Every booking is tracked as a deal in the CRM pipeline.

nodes.name: Create Deal (Deposit Pending)
nodes.notes: Deal stage doubles as the studio's at-a-glance status tracker across every open booking.

nodes.name: Create 30% Deposit Invoice
nodes.notes: Deposit is always 30% of the package price, calculated at send time rather than hardcoded per package.

parameters.subject: =Your studio booking, deposit invoice enclosed
parameters.message: =Hi {{ $json.body.first_name }}, thanks for booking your {{ $json.body.session_type }} session! To lock in {{ $json.body.session_date }}, please pay the attached deposit invoice within 5 days. We'll follow up automatically as the date approaches.

nodes.name: Send Invoice Email
nodes.notes: Confirms receipt of the booking immediately, before any payment status is known.

nodes.name: Wait Until Invoice Due
nodes.notes: Pauses the workflow execution itself, no separate scheduled workflow needed to check back in.

nodes.name: Check Invoice Payment Status
nodes.notes: Reads the live invoice status directly from Stripe rather than trusting a local flag.

nodes.name: IF Invoice Paid
nodes.notes: Splits the workflow into a confirmed path and a reminder/escalation path.

nodes.name: Confirm Session on Calendar
nodes.notes: Only ever added to the studio calendar once the deposit clears, so the calendar never shows unconfirmed holds as real bookings.

parameters.subject: You're confirmed! Session details enclosed
parameters.message: Deposit received, your session is officially on the calendar. We'll send a prep guide 48 hours before your shoot.

nodes.name: Send Confirmation Email
nodes.notes: Distinct from the initial booking email, confirms the deposit specifically.

parameters.text: =Session confirmed: {{ $('New Booking Submitted').item.json.body.first_name }} {{ $('New Booking Submitted').item.json.body.last_name }}, {{ $('New Booking Submitted').item.json.body.session_type }} on {{ $('New Booking Submitted').item.json.body.session_date }}.

nodes.name: Notify Studio Team
nodes.notes: Keeps the whole team aware of new confirmed sessions without anyone needing to check the CRM manually.

parameters.subject: Friendly reminder: deposit still pending
parameters.message: =Hi {{ $('New Booking Submitted').item.json.body.first_name }}, just a reminder that your deposit invoice for {{ $('New Booking Submitted').item.json.body.session_date }} is still outstanding. Let us know if you'd like a different payment method or have any questions.

nodes.name: Send Payment Reminder Email
nodes.notes: First reminder, kept friendly and low-pressure rather than an automatic penalty notice.

nodes.name: Wait 48 Hours
nodes.notes: Gives the reminder email time to land before checking payment status again.

nodes.name: Re-check Payment Status
nodes.notes: Second live status check rather than assuming the reminder worked.

nodes.name: IF Still Unpaid
nodes.notes: Second branch point. A late payment here still reconnects to the confirmed path rather than staying stuck.

parameters.text: =Deposit still unpaid after reminder: {{ $('New Booking Submitted').item.json.body.first_name }} {{ $('New Booking Submitted').item.json.body.last_name }}, session date {{ $('New Booking Submitted').item.json.body.session_date }}. Recommend a personal follow-up.

nodes.name: Escalate to Owner
nodes.notes: Escalations go to a separate, higher-attention channel than routine booking confirmations.

nodes.name: Flag Deal At-Risk in CRM
nodes.notes: So the studio's pipeline view reflects reality without anyone updating it by hand.

nodes.name: Missing Required Booking Field?
nodes.notes: Error-handling branch, catches a malformed booking submission before it creates a broken CRM record or invoice.

parameters.text: =Booking form submitted with a missing session date or email. Raw payload: {{ JSON.stringify($json.body) }}. Please follow up manually.

nodes.name: Notify - Malformed Booking
nodes.notes: Fallback so a bad submission is surfaced to a human instead of silently creating a broken deal or invoice.

meta.instructions: Sample workflow for portfolio purposes. Replace the HubSpot, Stripe, Gmail, Google Calendar, and Slack credentials with the client's own before deploying live. The late-payment branch reconnects into the same confirmed-session path rather than dead-ending, so a client who pays after the reminder still gets booked normally.
